answer_2.quote: We use lm-evaluation-harness to evaluate the open multilingual models in a 5shot setting.

answer_4.quote: 200 professional and community annotators reviewed 2,850 samples from the original English MMLU dataset, comprising 50 uniformly randomly selected questions from each of the 57 exam subjects.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked whether correctly answering each question required any of the following: (1) cultural knowledge, (2) geographic knowledge, or (3) dialect knowledge.
